recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a generated build reintroduces links from BackboneElement details to Element definitions or omits the BackboneElement.modifierExtension anchor.
issue_request: FHIR-16877 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 correction asking that BackboneElement detailed-description links point to BackboneElement detail definitions rather than Element detail definitions; the report noted this wrong link also meant no definition for modifierExtension.
initial_application: Historical commit 22d5233b31f33ae541736868584dea6fc8790a50 applied GF#16877 by changing the old source/backboneelement-definitions.html page from <%dictionary Element%> to <%dictionary BackboneElement%> and from elheader to belheader. The Jira comment records svn revision 14308, matching that commit.
additional_context: The old standalone source/backboneelement-definitions.html page no longer exists in current source after later type-framework refactors. Current source/fhir.ini keeps BackboneElement active and normative; source/types.html links BackboneElement details to types-definitions.html#BackboneElement; source/types-definitions.html renders <%dictionary BackboneElement%>; and source/datatypes/backboneelement.xml includes BackboneElement.modifierExtension.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the wrong Element detail link reported by FHIR-16877 is no longer present in current authoritative source.
